about:
515 Customized Woodworks LLC operates from Pleasant Hill, Iowa, serving the Greater Des Moines metro area. The company is organized as a small business LLC and has exhibited at the Des Moines fairgrounds arts and crafts shows for the past six years. No founding year or founder names are disclosed.

The shop builds custom, stand-alone furniture pieces including live-edge tables (coffee, dining, entry), drop-zone tables, and its signature Dog Den pet enclosures. Work is performed in a climate-controlled storage facility using locally harvested, kiln-dried hardwoods such as walnut, locust, elm, ash, and white oak up to 2.5 inches thick. Processes include epoxy repair and decorative inlay, spray-applied protective topcoats, and fabrication of both metal and hand-made wood leg systems. The company does not build chairs or handle built-in installations.

Customers are primarily residential buyers in the Des Moines region who commission one-off pieces or purchase from inventory shown at the Callahan Productions arts and crafts shows. The Dog Den line targets pet owners seeking a furniture-grade alternative to wire kennels, with sizes scaled to traditional kennel dimensions. The business does not ship outside Iowa; delivery is offered within the metro area for a fee, and customers may also pick up at the storage facility by appointment.

The company emphasizes a “hand-crafted with pride, not manufactured” philosophy, highlighting the uniqueness of each live-edge slab and the use of local materials. A 50% deposit is required to begin a custom project, with the balance due on completion.
